text: This must be the pirates' hideout Akula mentioned.\nLooks like a place from a folk tale, scary indeed.\nI guess there are no real pirates left anymore.
Alright, let's grab whatever we need to disguise\nourselves as pirates and leave immediately!
Found them!\nReal stuff just hits different!
I guess we're going with the skulls, huh?\nIt's the only way to hide the sparkle in our eyes\nand this saintly aura we're giving off~.
Or do you think we'll look more intimidating if we\njust rattle these weapons?
Well, let's just grab a bunch of stuff and think\nabout it later!
That damn enchantress! She trapped me in a tiny magic\nbottle just because I got a little rowdy!
It's been 300 years...\nBwahahaha, I'm finally free!
Pathetic humans!\nStupid scaly creatures! It's time for revenge!
